items.raw_excerpt: The Netherlands has recorded more tropical days in a single year than at any point since records began, after the temperature hit 31.5° in Maastricht on Tuesday. It was the 31st day this year on which 30° or more – the threshold for a tropical day – was reached somewhere in the country, beating the record of 30 set in 1947. Back then, the 30th tropical day did not arrive until September. This year the record fell in mid-August with...
items.summary_en: This year the Netherlands had 31 tropical days, the most ever recorded in one year. The old record of 30 was set back in 1947. The temperature reached 31.5 degrees in Maastricht on Tuesday.
items.summary_ko: 올해 네덜란드에서 기온이 30도를 넘는 열대일이 31일이나 돼 단일 연도 최다 기록을 세웠다. 종전 기록은 1947년에 세운 30일이었다. 지난 화요일 마스트리흐트에서 기온이 31.5도까지 올랐다.
items.title_en: Netherlands breaks 1947 heat record with 31 tropical days
